text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see Peter, leader of the Follower Scouts.
source_text: You see Peter, leader of the Follower Scouts.

text: What are you doing around here? Can't you see we are busy?
source_text: What are you doing around here? Can't you see we are busy?

text: Huh?
source_text: Huh?

text: I am sorry. I will go now.
source_text: I am sorry. I will go now.

text: Can I help you with anything?
source_text: Can I help you with anything?

text: Who can I talk to about giving my assistance.
source_text: Who can I talk to about giving my assistance.

text: Great. I'm busy, and I get a moron tailing me. Go look for Jake# if you need someone to talk to.
source_text:
Great. I'm busy, and I get a moron tailing me. Go look for Jake
# if you need someone to talk to.

text: Sure. You can start by getting out of my way.
source_text: Sure. You can start by getting out of my way.

text: Certainly. Anything else?
source_text: Certainly. Anything else?

text: There must be something more I can do.
source_text: There must be something more I can do.

text: Do not throw me to the side.
source_text: Do not throw me to the side.

text: Yes. You can get out of here.
source_text: Yes. You can get out of here.

text: Fine. It doesn't look like I will get rid of you any other way.# It seems that we are having a security problem. You want to help, you# find the problem.
source_text:
Fine. It doesn't look like I will get rid of you any other way.
# It seems that we are having a security problem. You want to help, you
# find the problem.

text: Okay. Will do.
source_text: Okay. Will do.

text: Forget it!
source_text: Forget it!

text: Fine. Get out then!
source_text: Fine. Get out then!

text: Look, we have a breach in security. We need to find this breach and end it.
source_text: Look, we have a breach in security. We need to find this breach and end it.

text: Ok. Will do.
source_text: Ok. Will do.

text: Forget it!
source_text: Forget it!

text: Do I look like a guide. Go talk to Jake if you are looking for a guide.
source_text: Do I look like a guide. Go talk to Jake if you are looking for a guide.

text: Leave. i am trying to finish up a little work.
source_text: Leave. i am trying to finish up a little work.

text: We need that spy gone. Hurry up!
source_text: We need that spy gone. Hurry up!

text: Good job on taking out Heather. I should have known it was her.# She always seemed to disappear in the raids. Here, take this and go.
source_text:
Good job on taking out Heather. I should have known it was her.
# She always seemed to disappear in the raids. Here, take this and go.

text: 你看到彼得，末世论者侦查员的首领。
source_text: 你看到彼得，末世论者侦查员的首领。

text: 你在这干什么呢？没看见我们正忙着吗？
source_text: 你在这干什么呢？没看见我们正忙着吗？

text: 啊？
source_text: 啊？

text: 抱歉。我这就走。
source_text: 抱歉。我这就走。

text: 我能帮你什么吗？
source_text: 我能帮你什么吗？

text: 我想来帮忙，我该跟谁谈？
source_text: 我想来帮忙，我该跟谁谈？

text: 真是太“棒”了。我这么忙，却还有个低能佬跟着我。你要想找人说话就找杰克去。
source_text: 真是太“棒”了。我这么忙，却还有个低能佬跟着我。你要想找人说话就找杰克去。

text: 当然了。你可以先滚开，其他的都好说。
source_text: 当然了。你可以先滚开，其他的都好说。

text: 当然。还有别的事吗？
source_text: 当然。还有别的事吗？

text: 肯定还有其他什么事是我可以做的。
source_text: 肯定还有其他什么事是我可以做的。

text: 别不搭理我。
source_text: 别不搭理我。

text: 是的。你可以离开了。
source_text: 是的。你可以离开了。

text: 好吧好吧。看来我怎样也甩不掉你。那警卫们有活干了。你这么寻求帮助只会给自己惹麻烦。
source_text: 好吧好吧。看来我怎样也甩不掉你。那警卫们有活干了。你这么寻求帮助只会给自己惹麻烦。

text: 好吧。就这样吧。
source_text: 好吧。就这样吧。

text: 算了。
source_text: 算了。

text: 好。那就给我走！
source_text: 好。那就给我走！

text: 瞧，是这样的，我们的保安系统里出现了点麻烦，得找出这个麻烦然后解决掉它。懂吗？
source_text: 瞧，是这样的，我们的保安系统里出现了点麻烦，得找出这个麻烦然后解决掉它。懂吗？

text: 好。就这样。
source_text: 好。就这样。

text: 算了。
source_text: 算了。

text: 我看起来象个导游吗？想要导游找杰克去。
source_text: 我看起来象个导游吗？想要导游找杰克去。

text: 走开。我正努力完成这工作。
source_text: 走开。我正努力完成这工作。

text: 我们要除掉那个叛徒。要快。
source_text: 我们要除掉那个叛徒。要快。

text: 除掉希瑟那件事，你干的不错。我早该知道是她。她总是行踪不定，走到歹徒那边就不见。给，拿了这个走吧。
source_text: 除掉希瑟那件事，你干的不错。我早该知道是她。她总是行踪不定，走到歹徒那边就不见。给，拿了这个走吧。
